verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a built-in way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows in Notion. Webhooks are event-triggered rather than time-based, Notion Skills are repeatable instruction pages with no schedule, and the "24/7 agents" line is marketing with no scheduling detail. The REST API and personal access tokens could be driven by an external scheduler, but that is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
